entry: @Mod constructor -> WizardsRebornItems.register(eventBus) -> DeferredRegister literal four ArcaneFortressArmorItem instances
material: ARCANE_FORTRESS: durability30 defenses[3,8,6,3] enchant30 toughness2 knockback0.15; unchanged reference values
client_chain: AddLayers bakes both; slim layer is instantiated through ArcaneFortressSlimArmorModel, inheriting the base ArmorModel aliases
initializeClient supplies getHumanoidArmorModel; non-default AbstractClientPlayer name selects slim; other entities default
ItemSkin may replace model; then slot and copyFromDefault plus setupAnim
getArmorTexture checks ItemSkin first; otherwise standard/slim same atlas for all four slots; no _layer_1/_layer_2 convention

default_alias_context.copyFromDefault: body/pelvis from original body; leggings/feet from original legs; head and arms inherited HumanoidModel animation. No claim about arbitrary poses.

skin_item_model_event: WizardsRebornItemSkins modelBakeSkins ModifyBakingResult calls FluffyFurItemSkins.addSkinModel for all four IDs; original JSON has no override but cannot guarantee resulting baked item model
